rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins: the box immediately left of the printed option. Item 1 date takes three combs (MM, DD, YYYY). Part III items 16-24 are one 14-slot comb per line with no centavo comb beside it, so they are plain joins, not money_joins. Part IV rows 25-28 are 33-slot combs spanning the Drawee Bank, Number, Date and Amount columns, so those row keys stay blank. The Schedule 1 grid (10 unlabeled rows, columns A-J) has no printed row numbers or product labels and stays blank; the total cell on the TOTAL EXCISE TAX DUE row joins to ACexciseTotal. Keys with no fillable cell (TIN parts and the second name line on page 2, signature names, Part IV name fields, the RDO comb which two keys could name) stay blank.
